HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Chel.]
Humming in ears. θ Valvular disease.
Loud roaring in ears, as from a distant storm of wind.
Ringing in left ear while walking.
Sensation of wind rushing out of ears.
Sensation as if ears were stopped.
Deafness associated with hepatic disorder.
Ears obstructed during cough ; deafness.
Pressure from occiput towards left ear. θ Hepatitis.
Burning or coldness of ears.
Sticking in ears.
Sticking and drawing in left ear.
Frequent tearing, extending from right ear into right teeth, in afternoon.
Tearing pain in internal ears.
Long-lasting stitch in external ear, going off gradually ; tearing in meatus and temporal bone ; tearing behind r. ear downward.
Itching in right concha.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Chel.]
Hallucinations of smell.
Dryness of nose.
Nose, tongue and throat dry. θ Influenza.
Coryza : dry, nose stopped ; fluent, with sneezing.
Thick blood in mucus in morning when blowing nose.
Itching of nose and tip of nose.
Twitching and tremor of tip of nose.
Swelling and redness of tip of nose.
Fanlike motion of nostrils.
Soreness of nostrils and flow of water from nose, with eruption like measles.
Feeling of soreness in nostrils ; dryness and itching, mostly left.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Chel.]
Expression : anxious, disturbed ; sickly, suffering ; collapse of features.
Face collapsed and pale. θ Prosopalgia. θ Intestinal catarrh. θ Pneumonia.
Countenance sunken, blue around eyes ; face pale or greyish or yellow ; changed complexion ; greyish-yellow complexion.
Dirty grey complexion. θ Cough.
Pale, dingy yellow color of face. θ Hepatitis.
Face red and swollen.
Redness in face did not disappear under pressure of the fingers. θ Erysipelas.
Face bright, then dark red ; one cheek red. θ Pneumonia.
Red, circumscribed spot on right cheek.
The usual redness of cheeks has a mixture of yellow, of a dark color.
Icteric, bloated face. θ Diabetes mellitus.
Greyish-yellow, sallow, sunken countenance. θ Hepatic affections. θ Dyspepsia.
Yellow color of face and hands, with yellow whites of eyes. θ Enlargement of liver. θ Jaundice.
Face puffy.
Flushes of heat in face. θ Mental affections.
Heat in face with dark red cheeks. θ Pneumonia.
Great and dry heat, most in face. θ Influenza.
Burning of cheeks.
Heat in face with red cheeks and chilliness ; with eruption like measles.
Supraorbital neuralgia, < right side ; eyes water ; throbbing pains ; shivering ; pains in eyes, head, ears ; temples tender on pressure ; > from cold water ; < from warmth, and at night in bed.
Pains in region of trigeminus, especially supraorbital. θ Bright's disease.
Violent tearing in maxillary antrum.
Jerking, tearing pain in right zygoma.
Pain in right cheek bone, and in upper part of occiput.
Pain in left malar bone.
Pressure and transient pains in upper maxilla.
Right cheek bone feels as if swollen.
Severe pressure in right maxilla in night on waking.
Tearing pain in right maxilla ; in antrum of Highmore.
Drawing pain from left maxilla to left eye and ear.
Drawing pain in left malar bone when lying down.
Slight convulsive twitches in face and limbs. θ Pneumonia.
Twitching of corners of mouth, with distortion of eyes. θ Intestinal catarrh.
Itching herpes, mostly on chin.
Burning pain like nettles, followed by red spots on face, around ears and under chin.
Red elevated spots on cheek, gradually growing larger and darker.
Inflamed sebaceous glands ; comedones.
Red pimples on different parts of face.
Inflamed pimples on face, more on chin and cheeks. θ Liver complaint.
On upper portion of right cheek, many red, elevated pimples, with prominent centres, and rough to touch.
Vesicles on lip and alæ nasi, forming scabs.
Nodular eruptions on face.
Face covered with scabs ; pale, œdematous. θ Pustular eruption.
Acne.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Chel.]
Lips burning, dry, chapped, scabby ; mouth dry with thirst.
Lips and gums pale. θ Intestinal catarrh.
Brown and dry coating on lips and teeth. θ Hepatic typhus.
Herpetic exanthema on lips and alæ nasi. θ Intermittent.
Vesicle full of serum on mucous membrane of lower lip.
Lower jaw drops. θ Influenza.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Chel.]
Drawing in upper incisors.
Drawing pain through middle incisors of lower jaw.
Tearing pains from right ear to right teeth, afternoons.
Toothache with facial neuralgia ; < from warmth and in bed at night ; > from cold water ; left lower molars ; jerking, tearing in antrum.
Toothache, chiefly in whole of left cheek, < at night.
Pressure or transient pain in teeth.
Gums pale. θ Intestinal catarrh.
Gums bleed.
